visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a lavender cat-print sweatshirt and light-colored shorts, stands outside a modern grey building. She smiles and gestures with her hands as the text "HELLO!" appears above her. The storefront has a sign that reads "Mr.D". (2) The scene shifts to an indoor entryway with black and white hexagonal floor tiles. A pair of pink fuzzy slippers with cartoon decorations are shown on the floor. The woman is seen walking into the showroom, carrying a small white designer crossbody bag. (3) Inside the brightly lit furniture showroom, the woman jumps onto several different sofas to test their comfort. She starts with a white modular sofa, then moves to a large grey L-shaped sofa, and finally a plush cream-colored sofa. Her expressions are joyful and exaggerated as she kicks her feet up. (4) Close-up shots highlight specific features of the sofas. The woman demonstrates the movable backrests of a beige sofa and points to fabric swatches. On-screen graphics show measurements like "120cm" and labels for different fabric types such as "Cotton/Linen" and "Cat-claw resistant". (5) The woman is shown relaxing on various sofas, looking directly at the camera while gesturing enthusiastically. The background features high ceilings, soft warm lighting, and a variety of other furniture pieces like coffee tables and rugs. (6) In the final phase, she sits comfortably on a large beige sofa, smiling and making peace signs towards the lens. The environment remains the well-organized, minimalist furniture showroom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice greeting the audience. The background music is an upbeat electronic pop track with a steady rhythmic beat. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the visual transition to the indoor entryway. The speaker's voice remains energetic as she describes the slippers, with a noticeable 'ding' sound effect when text appears. (3) As the speaker jumps on the sofas, soft percussive thudding sounds (muffled impact) are audible. Her voice exhibits high arousal with rising intonations and rapid speech. (4) A digital UI chime plays during the demonstration of the adjustable backrest. The music continues at a consistent tempo, providing a cheerful foundation for the technical explanations. (5) The speaker lists fabric choices with rhythmic delivery, each category emphasized by a light 'pop' SFX. The background music maintains its bright spectral profile. (6) The video concludes with the speaker expressing happiness, her voice reaching a high melodic peak, followed by a quick fade-out of the music and vocals.
